topic.title: IELTS Speaking Topic: Houses & Apartments
topic.description: Comprehensive speaking questions covering residential area, house/apartment features, preferences, and housing trends.

prompts.question_text: Where do you currently live?
ielts_tips: Give a direct short answer specifying location and structure, then explain.
prompts.examiner_tip: Avoid repeating key words in the question like 'I live in...'. Use 'I currently reside in...'.

response_structure.guide: I currently reside in a spacious high-rise apartment...
which is situated on the outskirts of the city.

prompts.question_text: What do you like most about your home?
ielts_tips: Use superlative structures or 'What I particularly enjoy is...'.
prompts.examiner_tip: Focus on 1 or 2 specific features rather than listing everything.

response_structure.guide: What I find really impressive is the spacious balcony...
since it offers a breathtaking panoramic view of the neighborhood.

prompts.question_text: If you could change anything about your home, what would it be?
ielts_tips: Use hypothetical structures: 'If I had the chance, I would...'.

response_structure.guide: Given that the kitchen is looking a bit run down...
it'd be great if we could have it completely renovated.

prompts.question_text: Describe the house or apartment that you live in.
ielts_tips: Set the scene, describe key features, share a personal experience or story, and state your overall feeling.
prompts.examiner_tip: Use 1 minute preparation time to outline a story about a problem or renovation.

response_structure.guide: As far back as I can remember, our family has lived in...
In terms of its appearance, it is a two-storey house equipped with...
I remember one time when we decided to redecorate...
Overall, it provides a warm and homely atmosphere.

prompts.question_text: What are the key differences between living in an apartment and a house?
ielts_tips: Use comparative structures: 'While houses offer more space, apartments provide...'.
prompts.examiner_tip: Speak about general societal trends rather than just your personal experience.

response_structure.guide: While living in a house usually offers greater privacy and space...
apartments are far more convenient in terms of security and location.

prompts.question_text: Why do some people prefer to buy rather than rent a home?
ielts_tips: Explain reasons using linking words: 'In the main, it's because...'.
prompts.examiner_tip: Include an example like housing market investments to support your point.

response_structure.guide: In the main, it's typically because buying a home represents a solid investment...
As well as this, owning property gives people complete freedom to make structural changes.

topic.title: IELTS Speaking Topic: Hometown & Neighbourhood
topic.description: Questions related to one's hometown, local amenities, changes over time, and urban vs rural living.

prompts.question_text: Can you tell me about your hometown?
ielts_tips: Combine short answer + most notable feature.
prompts.examiner_tip: Use vivid adjective collocations like 'bustling metropolis' or 'quaint country town'.

response_structure.guide: I was born and bred in...
and one of the most notable things about it is...

prompts.question_text: Has your hometown changed much since you were a child?
ielts_tips: Contrast past and present: 'While in the past... nowadays...'.
prompts.examiner_tip: Use present perfect tense to highlight changes over time.

response_structure.guide: While it used to be a small rural town when I was young...
nowadays it has transformed into a bustling metropolis with high-rise buildings.

prompts.question_text: Describe your hometown.
ielts_tips: Introduce setting, describe features, tell a story about an event in your hometown.
prompts.examiner_tip: Keep a steady pace and use complex sentences throughout the 2-minute speech.

response_structure.guide: As far back as I can remember, my hometown of...
It is renowned for its vibrant culture and rich historical landmarks...
I remember during the annual festival...
That experience made me appreciate the strong sense of community there.

prompts.question_text: Do you think large cities are more interesting to live in than small towns?
ielts_tips: Compare criteria like job opportunities, entertainment, and pace of life.
prompts.examiner_tip: Use contrastive structures like 'If you live in a city... whereas if you reside in a town...'.

topic.title: IELTS Speaking Topic: School & Education
topic.description: Questions about academic life, subjects, learning environments, and education systems.

prompts.question_text: What subject did you enjoy studying most at school?
ielts_tips: State subject + reason + example of a class activity.

response_structure.guide: What I particularly enjoyed was...
because the teacher created a highly stimulating learning environment.

prompts.question_text: Describe a subject that you enjoyed studying at school.
ielts_tips: Describe the subject, the teacher, a specific memorable incident, and what you gained.

response_structure.guide: When I started my second year in high school...
Her face is indelibly etched on my mind...
I remember one time during a science experiment...
It gave me the confidence to excel in academic pursuits.

prompts.question_text: Do you think private universities are better than public universities?
ielts_tips: Weigh both sides before concluding.

topic.title: IELTS Speaking Topic: Work & Career
topic.description: Questions on professions, workplace environment, career aspirations, and job satisfaction.

prompts.question_text: What are your main responsibilities at work?
ielts_tips: State primary responsibility + secondary duties + feeling.

prompts.question_text: Describe a job that you consider highly important.
ielts_tips: Describe job duties, challenges faced, and societal impact.

prompts.question_text: Why do so many businesses fail in their first year?
ielts_tips: Highlight key causes like cash flow issues and lack of experience.

topic.title: IELTS Speaking Topic: Family & Relationships
topic.description: Covering family dynamics, child upbringing, friendship bonds, and social connections.

prompts.question_text: Do you come from a large or small family?
ielts_tips: Mention size and who resides together.

prompts.question_text: Describe a friend with whom you like to spend your time.
useful_vocabulary: Like two peas in a pod
ielts_tips: Introduce friend, shared interests, a story where they helped you, and your bond.

prompts.question_text: How have relationships between parents and children changed in recent years?
ielts_tips: Contrast past strict discipline with modern democratic parenting.

topic.title: IELTS Speaking Topic: Celebrities & Role Models
topic.description: Topics regarding famous people, public influence, paparazzi, and media coverage.

prompts.question_text: Who is your favourite celebrity in your country?
ielts_tips: Mention why they are famous and their positive impact.

prompts.question_text: Describe a person who has done a lot of work to help people.
ielts_tips: Identify the person, their achievements, a specific project, and why they inspire you.

prompts.question_text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of being famous?
ielts_tips: Structure with 'The primary benefit is... whereas the main drawback is...'.

topic.title: IELTS Speaking Topic: Internet, Computers & Technology
topic.description: Questions on digital literacy, online activities, social networks, and technological evolution.

prompts.question_text: How often do you use the internet?
ielts_tips: State frequency and primary daily uses.

prompts.question_text: Describe a website or app that you often use.
ielts_tips: Detail when you first discovered it, key features, and how it solves a problem for you.

prompts.question_text: What are the limitations of technology when it comes to business relationships?
ielts_tips: Explain why face-to-face interaction remains superior for trust.

topic.title: IELTS Speaking Topic: Food & Cooking
topic.description: Questions regarding dietary habits, national cuisine, cooking skills, and dining preferences.

prompts.question_text: What is your favourite type of food?
ielts_tips: Mention specific dishes and describe taste and flavor.

prompts.question_text: Describe a dish that you like.
ielts_tips: Describe ingredients, preparation, when you first ate it, and why you enjoy it.

prompts.question_text: Why is it important for families to eat meals together?
ielts_tips: Highlight emotional and psychological benefits for family unity.

topic.title: IELTS Speaking Topic: Travel & Tourism
topic.description: Exploring vacation choices, tourist destinations, cultural exchange, and eco-tourism.

prompts.question_text: Do you prefer traveling independently or on a package tour?
ielts_tips: Contrast independent travel with group tours.

prompts.question_text: Describe a tourist attraction you once visited.
ielts_tips: Detail setting, activities, a minor challenge/problem, and the final feeling.

prompts.question_text: What negative impacts can international tourism have on local communities?
ielts_tips: Mention littering, rise in prices, and loss of local culture.

topic.title: IELTS Speaking Topic: Environmental Problems & Sustainability
topic.description: Questions on climate change, pollution, conservation efforts, and individual responsibility.

prompts.question_text: What do you do to help protect the environment?
ielts_tips: Mention small daily actions like saving electricity and using reusable bags.

prompts.question_text: Describe an environmental problem in your country.
ielts_tips: Define the issue, explain root causes, describe personal experience, and suggest solutions.

prompts.question_text: What should governments do to address global warming?
ielts_tips: Focus on policy changes like investing in solar/wind power and penalizing heavy polluters.
